title: Sudanese Forces Intercept Kornet Anti-Tank Missile Launcher, Smuggled Arms on Red Sea Coast
detail: Sudanese customs and General Intelligence Service forces intercepted a cache of smuggled military hardware south of Red Sea State on September 12, 2026, including a Russian-made 9M133 Kornet anti-tank guided missile launcher, 1,190 rifle magazines, 15 US-made pistols, and three Brazilian-made handguns. The laser-guided Kornet is capable of piercing advanced tank armor and hardened fortifications, and its interception underscores growing concern over maritime arms-trafficking networks feeding the war. Authorities did not identify the shipment's intended recipients or announce any arrests.

sources.name: Sudan Tribune — Sudan seizes Kornet missile system, smuggled arms on Red Sea coast

media.caption: Sudanese security forces intercepted a Kornet anti-tank missile launcher and other smuggled arms south of Red Sea State on September 12, 2026.

confidenceReason: Based on a single Tier-2 outlet's report of a Sudanese government interdiction announcement; no independent corroboration found.
